answer: A bond is refunded only after 33 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The harbor counter is kept in karst and echo exposes each reset. An adversary thus has to keep each alias continuously active for 33 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1077 identities would post 4652 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
